title: Pakistani gunsmith who hammers out AKs from aircraft scrap on a granite rock

tellings.quote: there's a guy that lives just cross the border in Pakistan lives in a mud hut

plain: Just over the Afghan border in Pakistan, a man living in a mud hut is said to hammer out working AK rifles from scrap aircraft metal on a granite rock. A guest named Joe McMoneagle tells Michels this as something he was told. It is a story about how much a skilled craftsman can do with almost nothing.
